messages.content: Produce exactly five distinct grammatical paraphrases of the robot instruction supplied as data. Preserve the action, moved object, object names, colors, identifiers, destination, relations, quantities and action order. Do not change an action into a static description. In or inside a container must not become on a surface or merely to a destination. Near does not mean touching, and touching does not mean near. Do not infer the meaning of ambiguous verbs such as put up from text alone. Do not add scene details. Output only {"paraphrases":["...","...","...","...","..."]}. No original reuse, duplicates or extra fields. If five faithful variants are not possible, output only {"abstain_reason":"specific reason"}. Never fill missing variants with weaker goals.
{"original_instruction": "put the silver pot to the lower right of the burner"}
